name: rtcweb2lan
description: Access intranet web apps from any browser with an unchanged URL: Service Worker interception over a peer-to-peer WebRTC DataChannel, no intranet app changes.

scripts.build: pnpm --dir fdn/web build && pnpm run build:go
scripts.build:go: cd agent && go build -o ../.dev-bin/fdn ./cmd/fdn && go build -o ../.dev-bin/tunnelagent ./cmd/tunnelagent
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run test:go
